kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أنصهر (form VII)
# أَنْصَهِرُ (ʔanṣahiru) /ʔan.sˤa.hi.ru/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْصَهَرَ (inṣahara)
# أَنْصَهِرَ (ʔanṣahira) /ʔan.sˤa.hi.ra/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْصَهَرَ (inṣahara)
# أَنْصَهِرْ (ʔanṣahir) /ʔan.sˤa.hir/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْصَهَرَ (inṣahara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
